report.text: PARTIAL. The packaging half of the task is done and verified; the turn-it-on half was not reached. DONE: semgrep and license-check now fall back to plugin-shipped defaults resolved relative to the script's own on-disk location, never rootDir, so a candidate tree cannot supply its own scanner config; a project that ships its own file still wins. This closes the mixed plugin-cache/project-path split the greenfield run complained about. The dispatch also recorded a genuinely measured defect behind it: semgrep's own 'auto' registry mode fails outright under this codebase's fixed SEMGREP_SEND_METRICS=off with 'Cannot create auto config when metrics are off', so a project configuring nothing was guaranteed an ERROR rather than a scan. A minimal default ruleset ships with a behavioural test proving its private-key rule actually fires on a real PEM block. DoD 4's five reader-facing statuses are implemented additively as scanners[].reportStatus, applied uniformly after the run loop so no entry shape is left unlabeled, and existing consumers matching on status/classification are untouched. NOT DONE, and not claimed: DoD 1 (measure the three offending required capabilities) has no recorded measurement; DoD 5 (correct the two stale reasons in the security seeding comment) was not performed; DoD 6 (measure whether security can now be seeded to a real mode) was not performed, and gates.security is therefore correctly left at 'off' -- an unmeasured seed was explicitly forbidden by the briefing. Verified by the orchestrator on the worktree: security-scan.test.mjs 135/135 exit 0; semgrep-default-rules.test.mjs 7/7 exit 0.
